children: TrueBlue reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $520.74 million, up 20.7% year over year. Net income was $9.25 million, compared with a net loss of $1.92 million a year earlier, while diluted EPS was $0.28 versus a loss of $0.06 per share.
¹ Reported as “Revenue from services”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per common share”.
PeopleReady revenue grew 34.4%; energy work more than doubled, and on-demand business returned to growth for a second consecutive quarter.
PeopleManagement revenue increased 1.9%, with commercial driving demand offsetting lower OnSite volumes.
PeopleSolutions revenue grew 0.9%, as permanent placement hiring gains were partly offset by healthcare staffing declines.
Cost-management actions streamlined operations and improved segment profitability as revenue grew.
